messages:
emma: Following up on last night's routing/TLS spike. Root cause summary in postmortem: probe timeout + cipher fallback -> old pool selection -> client retry amplification. Filing action items here for ownership and ETAs.

ops-bot: Postmortem uploaded: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-04-02-routing-tls-spike (tags: lb, tls, dns)

rick: Noted. The routing probe timeout was 150ms; when transient latency hit we immediately fell back to legacy SNI pool. That pool can't handle the burst.

jun: I'll take the routing config change: raise probe timeout to 800ms and add a 10s grace window before fallback. Will test in staging then canary. ETA: 2026-04-08.

emma: please include a preflight smoke that forces region header and verifies preferred pool responses. Minimal example: 
```
curl -H "X-Debug-Region: eu-west" https://edge.redwood.ai/health | grep preferred_pool
```

rick: also proposing short mitigation: during cert rotates, disable immediate cipher fallback for 5m windows. Ops signoff required.

infra-sre: I'll schedule a 4-week regression check every Tue 10:00 UTC; will add dashboard panels for retry_rate_by_pool and tls_handshake_failures.

jun: action items summary:
- JUN: routing probe + graceful-fallback (owner) — ETA 2026-04-08
- RICK: coordinate cert-rotation window + mitigation plan (owner) — ETA 2026-04-05
- EMMA: add smoke test + runbook steps (owner) — ETA 2026-04-04 COB
- INFRA-SRE: schedule weekly regression sync + dashboards (owner) — scheduled starting 2026-04-06

emma: thx team. update PR/issue with concrete runbook steps and monitoring thresholds. I'll close thread once canary is stable for 24h. :white_check_mark:
